# Jubilees Chapter 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Demons Unleashed; The Adversary Bargains; Noah's Healing Book; Tower of Babel

---

**10:1** In the third week of this jubilee, unclean demons began infiltrating the families of Noah's grandchildren — leading them astray, confusing them, and destroying them.

**10:2** Noah's sons came to him and reported what was happening: demons were blinding their children, leading them off course, and killing them.

**10:3** Noah prayed to the LORD his God: "God who governs every living spirit — you showed me mercy. You pulled me and my sons out of the floodwaters and did not let me perish with those who were destroyed. You have been enormously gracious to me. Please extend that grace to my children too. Don't let evil spirits rule over them and wipe them out."

**10:4** "Bless me and my sons. Let us grow, multiply, and fill the earth."

**10:5** "You know what your Watchers — the fathers of these demons — did in my time. These spirits are still out there: lock them up, chain them in the place of punishment. Don't let them bring ruin on your servant's family. They are vicious. They were built for destruction."

**10:6** "Don't let them rule over the living — only you have that authority. Let them have no power over righteous people, ever again."

**10:7** The LORD our God ordered us to chain all of them.

**10:8** But then the chief of the spirits — Mastema — stepped forward and argued: "Lord and Creator, leave some of them under my command. Let them obey me and carry out my orders. If you take them all away, I won't be able to exercise my function over human beings. These spirits exist to corrupt and mislead people as they face judgment — and human wickedness is enormous."

**10:9** God ruled: "Leave a tenth of them under him. The other nine-tenths go down to the place of punishment."

**10:10** God then ordered one of us to teach Noah all the ways to counteract the demons — because he knew that people would not stay on the right path or hold to righteousness.

**10:11** We carried out every order: we chained the nine-tenths of the evil spirits in the place of punishment, and left the remaining tenth to answer to Satan on earth.

**10:12** We explained to Noah every remedy for the diseases the demons cause and all the ways the demons seduce people — how to counter them using the plants of the earth. Noah recorded everything in a book, exactly as we dictated: a complete manual of medicine. With this, the evil spirits were blocked from harming Noah's descendants.

**10:13** Noah gave the entire written record to his eldest son Shem, whom he loved above all his sons.

**10:14** Noah died and was buried on Mount Lubar in the land of Ararat.

**10:15** He had lived nine hundred and fifty years — nineteen jubilees, two weeks, and five years.

**10:16** He was the most righteous and upright person who ever lived — except for Enoch. Enoch's role was different: he was the cosmic recorder, the witness of all history. But Noah himself was righteous, blameless, and entirely faithful in everything he did.

**10:17** In the thirty-third jubilee, second week, first year, Peleg married Lomna daughter of Sina'ar. In the fourth year of that week she gave birth to a son he named Reu, saying: "The children of men have gone wicked — evil plans and evil deeds." And in Reu's days they built the tower, announcing: "We will climb all the way up to heaven."

**10:18** They started building. In the fourth week they stopped. By then the tower stood three hundred and forty-three cubits tall — so high it was visible from a great distance, its top reaching into the sky. People across the entire earth stopped what they were doing to watch. In those days the whole human race still spoke one language.

**10:19** It was Mastema who pushed this whole project forward. He dispatched his subordinate spirits to urge the people to build the city and the tower.

**10:20** The cry went out: "We will ascend to heaven!" In those same days, the powerful ruler Naram held power as Pharaoh.

**10:21** The LORD our God came down to see the city and the tower that humanity had built.

**10:22** He shattered their shared language. Suddenly no one could understand anyone else, and the building project collapsed.

**10:23** That is why the whole region of Shinar is called Babel — because that is where the LORD scrambled all the languages of humanity. From there, people scattered to their own cities, each nation by its own language.

**10:24** The LORD then sent a violent wind against the tower and knocked it down to the ground. Its ruins lay between Asshur and Babylon in the land of Shinar. People called it "The Overthrow."

**10:25** In the thirty-fourth jubilee, first year of the fourth week, the great scattering from Shinar happened.

**10:26** Ham and his family went to the land they had taken — land that wasn't their proper allotment — in the west, by the sea.

**10:27** And Canaan looked out at the land of Lebanon, down to the Jordan and the coastline, and seized it for himself.

---
*PNEUMA notes: Mastema's argument (v.8) is rendered as a legal petition to convey its formal character. The 1/10 demons permitted to remain under Mastema (vv.9-11) is Jubilees' explanation of ongoing evil. Noah's medical book (v.12) is a genuine healing-text tradition. Tower as Mastema's project (v.19) is Jubilees' distinctive attribution.*
